points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 1685年3月12日，贝克莱出生于爱尔兰基尔肯尼的一个贵族家庭。他的父亲是当地的一位绅士，家境殷实。贝克莱从小就展现出非凡的智力，11岁时进入基尔肯尼学院学习，在那里接受了古典教育，学习了拉丁语、希腊语、法语和希伯来语，以及数学和哲学。这段早期教育为他后来的学术生涯奠定了坚实基础，特别是他对古典哲学的浓厚兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Born on March 12, 1685, in Kilkenny, Ireland, into an aristocratic family, Berkeley showed exceptional intellectual abilities from a young age. At 11, he entered Kilkenny College, where he received a classical education in Latin, Greek, French, Hebrew, mathematics, and philosophy. This early education laid the foundation for his later academic career, particularly his deep interest in classical philosophy.

points.title: 三一学院求学
points.description: 1700年，15岁的贝克莱进入都柏林三一学院学习。在这里，他系统学习了哲学、数学和古典文学，对洛克的经验主义哲学产生了浓厚兴趣。1704年，他获得学士学位，随后继续深造。1706年，他发表了第一篇哲学论文《视觉新论》，探讨了视觉与触觉的关系，这标志着他哲学思想的初步形成。在三一学院的这段时间，贝克莱开始构建自己独特的哲学体系，为后来的主观唯心主义理论奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1700, at age 15, Berkeley entered Trinity College Dublin, where he systematically studied philosophy, mathematics, and classical literature, developing a keen interest in Locke's empiricism. He received his bachelor's degree in 1704 and continued his studies. In 1706, he published his first philosophical essay, 'An Essay Towards a New Theory of Vision,' exploring the relationship between sight and touch, marking the beginning of his philosophical thought. During his time at Trinity College, Berkeley began constructing his unique philosophical system, laying the foundation for his later subjective idealism.

points.title: 早期学术生涯
points.description: 1707年，贝克莱被任命为三一学院的初级研究员，开始他的学术生涯。1710年，他发表了代表作《人类知识原理》，系统阐述了他的主观唯心主义哲学，即'存在即被感知'的理论。1713年，他出版了《海拉斯和斐洛诺斯的三篇对话》，进一步发展了他的哲学思想。1714年，他前往欧洲大陆游历，在法国和意大利广泛接触当时的学术思想。1718年，他回到爱尔兰，被任命为德鲁莫尔教区的副主教。这一时期，贝克莱的哲学思想逐渐成熟，他的'唯心主义'理论在哲学界引起了广泛讨论。
points.descriptionEn: In 1707, Berkeley was appointed a Junior Fellow at Trinity College, beginning his academic career. In 1710, he published his major work 'A Treatise Concerning the Principles of Human Knowledge,' systematically expounding his subjective idealist philosophy, the theory that 'to be is to be perceived.' In 1713, he published 'Three Dialogues between Hylas and Philonous,' further developing his philosophical ideas. In 1714, he traveled to continental Europe, engaging with contemporary academic thought in France and Italy. In 1718, he returned to Ireland and was appointed Dean of Dromore. During this period, Berkeley's philosophical ideas matured, and his 'idealism' theory sparked widespread discussion in philosophical circles.

points.title: 美洲计划
points.description: 1724年，贝克莱决定前往美洲，希望在那里建立一所学院，传播他的哲学思想并培养传教士。1728年，他抵达美国罗德岛的纽波特，并购买了农场。他计划将这片土地发展为一个学术和宗教中心，命名为'百慕大学院'。然而，由于资金不足和英国政府支持有限，这一计划最终未能实现。尽管如此，贝克莱在美洲期间继续写作，完成了《阿尔西弗龙》和《西雷斯》等哲学著作。这段经历使贝克莱对北美殖民地有了深入了解，也影响了他后来的政治和宗教观点。
points.descriptionEn: In 1724, Berkeley decided to travel to America, hoping to establish a college there to propagate his philosophical ideas and train missionaries. In 1728, he arrived in Newport, Rhode Island, and purchased a farm. He planned to develop this land into an academic and religious center, naming it 'Bermuda College.' However, due to insufficient funding and limited support from the British government, this plan ultimately failed. Despite this, Berkeley continued writing during his time in America, completing philosophical works such as 'Alciphron' and 'Siris.' This experience gave Berkeley a deep understanding of the North American colonies and influenced his later political and religious views.

points.title: 晚年回归
points.description: 1732年，贝克莱回到英国，最初在伦敦活动。1734年，他被任命为克罗因教区主教，移居牛津。在牛津期间，贝克莱继续他的学术研究，同时履行宗教职责。他晚年对化学和医学产生了浓厚兴趣，提出了'柏克莱塔'（一种用于蒸馏水的装置）的发明。1752年，他退休并移居牛津附近的牛津大学。1753年1月14日，贝克莱在牛津去世，享年67岁。他的去世标志着18世纪早期英国经验主义哲学的一个重要时代的结束，他的哲学思想对后来的康德、休谟等哲学家产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1732, Berkeley returned to Britain, initially active in London. In 1734, he was appointed Bishop of Cloyne and moved to Oxford. During his time in Oxford, Berkeley continued his academic research while fulfilling his religious duties. In his later years, he developed a keen interest in chemistry and medicine, inventing the 'Berkeley funnel' (a device for distilling water). In 1752, he retired and moved near Oxford University. Berkeley died in Oxford on January 14, 1753, at the age of 67. His death marked the end of an important era in early 18th-century British empiricist philosophy, and his ideas had a profound influence on later philosophers such as Kant and Hume.

supporter.zh: 贝克莱被视为哲学史上最具创新性的思想家之一。他的主观唯心主义理论挑战了当时流行的物质主义观点，提出了'存在即被感知'的革命性理念。支持者认为，贝克莱的哲学为理解人类认知提供了独特视角，强调了心灵在构建现实中的核心作用。他的工作为后来的现象学和存在主义哲学奠定了基础，对现代心理学和认知科学也有深远影响。贝克莱不仅是一位哲学家，还是一位教育家和社会改革者，他的美洲计划虽然失败，但体现了他对知识普及和社会进步的热忱。
supporter.en: Berkeley is regarded as one of the most innovative thinkers in the history of philosophy. His subjective idealist theory challenged the prevailing materialist views of his time, proposing the revolutionary concept that 'to be is to be perceived.' Supporters argue that Berkeley's philosophy provided a unique perspective for understanding human cognition, emphasizing the central role of the mind in constructing reality. His work laid the foundation for later phenomenological and existential philosophies and had a profound impact on modern psychology and cognitive science. Berkeley was not only a philosopher but also an educator and social reformer; his American project, though unsuccessful, reflected his enthusiasm for knowledge dissemination and social progress.

critic.zh: 批评者认为贝克莱的哲学体系存在严重缺陷。首先，他的'存在即被感知'理论面临逻辑困境：如果无人感知时物质不存在，那么宇宙如何在没有人类意识的情况下存在？其次，贝克莱过度强调主观经验，忽视了客观世界的独立存在，这被认为是对科学方法的挑战。批评者还指出，贝克莱试图调和科学与宗教的做法显得牵强，他的神学论证缺乏说服力。此外，贝克莱的政治观点被认为过于保守，他对美洲原住民的态度也反映了当时殖民主义的局限性。这些批评者认为，贝克莱的哲学虽然富有启发性，但在逻辑严密性和现实适用性方面存在明显不足。
critic.en: Critics argue that Berkeley's philosophical system has serious flaws. First, his 'to be is to be perceived' theory faces logical dilemmas: if material objects don't exist when unperceived, how could the universe exist without human consciousness? Second, Berkeley's overemphasis on subjective experience neglects the independent existence of the objective world, which is seen as challenging to scientific methodology. Critics also point out that Berkeley's attempt to reconcile science and religion appears forced, and his theological arguments lack persuasiveness. Additionally, Berkeley's political views are considered overly conservative, and his attitude toward Native Americans reflects the limitations of colonialism. These critics maintain that while Berkeley's philosophy is inspiring, it has significant shortcomings in logical rigor and practical applicability.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，贝克莱被定位为18世纪英国经验主义哲学的重要代表人物，介于洛克和休谟之间。他的哲学思想虽然在当时引起争议，但对后世产生了深远影响。在学术领域，贝克莱被视为认识论和形而上学的关键人物，他的工作促使后来的哲学家重新思考感知、现实和意识的关系。在流行文化中，贝克莱的名字常常与'唯心主义'联系在一起，成为哲学入门课程中的经典案例。他的名言'存在即被感知'已成为哲学史上最著名的命题之一。贝克莱的多才多艺也使他成为启蒙时期知识分子的典型代表，其思想跨越哲学、神学、科学和教育等多个领域。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Berkeley is positioned as a key figure in 18th-century British empiricist philosophy, situated between Locke and Hume. Although his philosophical ideas were controversial at the time, they had a profound impact on later thought. In academia, Berkeley is regarded as a pivotal figure in epistemology and metaphysics, whose work prompted later philosophers to reconsider the relationships between perception, reality, and consciousness. In popular culture, Berkeley's name is often associated with 'idealism,' becoming a classic case study in introductory philosophy courses. His famous maxim 'to be is to be perceived' has become one of the most well-known propositions in the history of philosophy. Berkeley's versatility also makes him a typical representative of Enlightenment intellectuals, with his ideas spanning philosophy, theology, science, and education.

self.en: To be is to be perceived.

others.zh: 贝克莱主教是一位才华横溢、思想敏锐的人，但他的哲学体系建立在一个根本性的谬误之上，即认为物质实体依赖于心灵的存在。
others.en: Bishop Berkeley was a man of great talent and sharp intellect, but his philosophical system is built upon a fundamental error, namely that material substances depend on the existence of minds.
